claims: As of March 17, 2026, power outages in Northern Virginia/DC are concentrated in Fairfax County (~1,150+ customers) and Stafford County (~5,600+ customers).
As of March 17, 2026, power outages in Northern Virginia/DC include smaller outages in Spotsylvania and Fredericksburg.
Fairfax County has ~1,153 customers out of power.
The ~1,153 customers out of power in Fairfax County are primarily served by Dominion Energy.
Stafford County has ~5,643 customers out of power.
Dominion Energy and NOVEC are addressing repairs.
Power outages in Spotsylvania/Fredericksburg are often managed by Rappahannock Electric Coop.
